# kayjs-ui

> Components for kay apps. They ship as `.kay` sources that the app compiles as its own, and they are styled by the classes of one `theme.css`, which the app restyles from its own stylesheet. The set: buttons and icons, toasts, dialogs and a form dialog that calls a page's action, a sortable table, switches, checkboxes and chips, tabs and segmented controls, inputs, selects and pickers, cards, badges, notices, avatars, popovers and tooltips, page layouts and panels, a command palette, a tree view, charts, drag and drop, a markdown editor, media galleries, a cropper, pagination, QR codes, and a carousel, a star rating and a site menu for marketing pages.

## Rules that are easy to get wrong

- Import each component by its `.kay` path: `import Button from '@kaynooo/kayjs-ui/button.kay'`. Types, `toast`, `attempt`, `messageOf`, `editing`, `infiniteList` and the defaults come from the package itself: `import { toast } from '@kaynooo/kayjs-ui'`, and the drag and drop controllers from `@kaynooo/kayjs-ui/dnd`.
- Components write no Tailwind utility, only the classes of `theme.css`, every one prefixed `kui-` as its tokens are, so a site's own `btn`, `card` or `--color-accent` never meets them. A rule of the app's on one of those classes restyles every instance, and `--kui-border-width` sets the keyline of every framed box; utilities passed through a component's `class` prop restyle one.
- Any parent, a layout and a page included, passes an island children and slots without parameters, which the server renders as static markup. A component or a page without a `--- server` fence passing one a function, a block with parameters or a class instance (such as Tabs' `@panel`, a Table's `@cell` or a function `rowKey`) renders as an island itself; a layout, or a page with a `--- server` fence, cannot, and moves that markup into a component of its own.
- `toast` only shows in the browser, called from an island. The server's toast list, shared by every request, stays empty. `ui()` in kay.config.ts mounts one `Toaster`, one `TooltipHost` and the theme on every page. An extension may render its own: while one is mounted, a second renders nothing until the first unmounts.
- An icon is either a slot name such as `'close'`, which the app's settings map to any icon set, or an icon imported from `~icons/<prefix>/<name>`. The default slots use Tabler, so the app installs `@iconify-json/tabler`.
- Dialog and FormDialog follow `open`. The parent sets it, then sets it back to false in `onOpenChange(open)`, which every disclosure takes (Dialog, SidePanel, FormDialog, CommandPalette, Popover) and runs however the dialog closed. Their content renders only while they are open. A Popover the page opens through `open` is set back the same way, in `onOpenChange`.
- One vocabulary: `variant` names a form (`solid`, `ghost`, `inline`) and `tone` a meaning (`neutral`, `accent`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info`; each component takes the ones it draws), `size` is `xs`, `sm`, `md` or `lg`, and an option is `{ value, label, icon?, disabled? }`. `label` is the visible text of a component that draws it and the accessible name of one that does not (IconButton, Menu, the groups).
- FormDialog calls the action with the form's `FormData`. The server reads it as a plain form post, so give each control the `name` of its field in the action's schema: numbers, booleans and lists are coerced from their text, and files and the honeypot come along.
- Messages about the app's data are its own, passed as props (`failure`, `message`, `label`). The library's own words (`Close`, `Cancel`, `Loading…`...) are looked up in the app's catalogs under `ui.<component>.<prop>` keys, `ui.sidePanel.closeLabel`, before their English, and a prop given to the component replaces both. The French of every key ships with the library and is read on a French page with no setup. Every key is listed in [Texts and languages](llms/words.md).

## Topics

The rest by topic, each file read whole with one command:

- [Setup, settings and testing](llms/setup.md): installing the theme and components, the settings that map icons, testing an app that uses it
- [Icons, buttons, toasts, dialogs, cards, popovers and stats](llms/basics.md): Icon, Button, toast, Dialog, ConfirmDelete, Card, Badge, Notice, Avatar, Popover, TooltipHost, Stat, Meter, BarList, CopyButton, Rating
- [Inputs, selects, editors and forms](llms/forms.md): TextInput, Textarea, Select, RangeInput, MultiSelect, FileDrop, Menu, IconPicker, MarkdownEditor, and forms with FormDialog
- [Tables, tabs, pagination, page layout, command palette and trees](llms/tables-navigation-and-layout.md): Table, Segmented, Tabs, TabNav, SiteNav, AppHeader, Toggle, Checkbox, Pagination, QrCode, PageHeader, SidePanel, SplitLayout, CommandPalette, TreeView
- [Texts and languages](llms/words.md): the `ui.*` messages that word every default text, and the page's locale in charts
- [Charts, drag and drop, galleries and image tools](llms/charts-drag-and-media.md): LineChart, ScatterChart, ContributionGraph, Sortable, Board, DropTargets, MediaGallery, Carousel, Masonry, WhenVisible, LoadMore, VirtualList, ZoomPane, ImageCropper
